name: Lazy Image
description: Defers an image request until it nears the viewport, showing a placeholder and fading the image in on load.
usage:
<LazyImage
  src="/charts/signups.png"
  alt="Bar chart of quarterly signups"
  width={640}
  height={360}
/>

anatomy.description: The sized box observed against the rootMargin threshold.
A pulsing surface, or any custom node, holding layout until the image loads.
The img whose src is requested only near the viewport, fading in via data-state.

dos: Pass width and height so the layout is reserved and the page does not shift.
Write meaningful alt text; it applies as soon as the img mounts.
Use a custom placeholder that hints at the incoming content.
donts: Don't lazy-load hero or above-the-fold images; they should render immediately.
Don't set rootMargin so large that every image loads up front.
Don't use it for icons and decorative graphics; a plain img is simpler.

examples.title: Default placeholder
examples.description: A pulsing surface holds the layout until the image scrolls near the viewport and finishes loading.

examples.title: Custom placeholder
examples.description: Any React node can stand in for the image, such as a branded blur-up or an explanatory caption.

guidance.useWhen: Image-heavy pages where most media sits below the fold, such as galleries, dashboards, or documentation.
guidance.avoidWhen: Hero or above-the-fold images that should render immediately; a plain img with fetchpriority is a better fit.
guidance.behavior: Requests src only when the wrapper crosses the rootMargin threshold, keeps data-state from idle through loading to loaded, and loads immediately without IntersectionObserver.
guidance.responsive: Accepts explicit width and height; pass percentages through style and the image fills the wrapper with object-fit cover.

notes: The alt text is required and applied to the img as soon as it mounts, so the accessible name never depends on load state.
The fade-in transition is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.description: Height of the image in pixels.
props.name: height

props.description: Content shown until the image finishes loading.
props.name: placeholder

props.description: Margin around the viewport at which loading starts, e.g. `'200px'`.
props.name: rootMargin

props.description: Image URL, requested only once the image nears the viewport.
props.name: src

props.description: Portion of the wrapper that must be visible before loading starts, from 0 to 1.
props.name: threshold

props.description: Width of the image in pixels.
props.name: width
